tagline: You can now share metric views with Databricks users in other metastores or accounts using OpenSharing.
what_it_does: You can now share metric views with Databricks users in other metastores or accounts using OpenSharing. As a recipient, you read data and notebooks shared with you using the Databricks to Databricks OpenSharing protocol, where Databricks manages a secure connection for data sharing. Unlike the OpenSharing open sharing protocol, the Databricks to Databricks protocol does not require a credential file (token based security).
